description: This script is a command-line tool for downloading and applying patches from GitHub pull requests to a local PyTorch installation. It handles argument parsing, retrieves the PyTorch path, downloads patches, and applies them via the 'patch' utility.

methods.name: argparse.Namespace parse_arguments()
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments for PR number, target directory, and strip count.

methods.name: str get_pytorch_path()
methods.description: Retrieves the installation path of PyTorch in the current environment.

methods.name: NoReturn handle_import_error()
methods.description: Handles the case when PyTorch is not installed and exits.

methods.name: str download_patch(pr_number: int, repo_url: str, download_dir: str)
methods.description: Downloads the patch file for a specified PR from GitHub.

methods.name: None apply_patch(patch_file: str, target_dir: str | None, strip_count: int)
methods.description: Applies a downloaded patch to the specified directory using the 'patch' utility.

methods.name: None main()
methods.description: Main orchestrator function that parses arguments, downloads, and applies the patch.

ctags.name: apply_patch
ctags.pattern: /^def apply_patch(patch_file: str, target_dir: str | None, strip_count: int) -> None:$/
ctags.signature: (patch_file: str, target_dir: str | None, strip_count: int)

ctags.name: download_patch
ctags.pattern: /^def download_patch(pr_number: int, repo_url: str, download_dir: str) -> str:$/
